# libwebp 1.6.0

Source: https://github.com/webmproject/libwebp/tree/v1.6.0

The unmodified `.c` and `.h` files from `src/` and `sharpyuv/` are compiled statically by the CWebP SwiftPM target. `COPYING`, `PATENTS` and `AUTHORS` are retained. Build systems, example programs and tests are not included. No system or Homebrew libwebp is linked at runtime.
